title: Arydia: The Paths We Dare Tread
subtitle: An epic open-world tabletop RPG adventure of exploration, tactical combat, and emergent storytelling
tagline: Unfurl an uncharted continent and carve your destiny into living legend
loreSummary: Exiled to the wild and perilous continent of Arydia, you and your companions must brave uncharted wilderness, delve into forgotten ruins, and aid struggling settlements to earn your pardon and decide the realm'''s fate.
keyFeatures: Living open world with modular hex maps and dynamic location unfolding
Green legacy architecture with persistent world state and full replayability
Deterministic puzzle-like tactical combat powered by Path specialization
Comprehensive card catalog indexing system for rapid setup and seamless saves

arydia_standard.name: Standard Overland Expedition
arydia_standard.description: The core campaign experience spanning the main pardon arc, major provincial storylines, and significant wilderness exploration.

arydia_story.name: Path of Pardon (Story Focus)
arydia_story.description: A focused journey prioritizing the essential quests and narrative milestones needed to secure your royal pardon.

arydia_completionist.name: Chronicles of Arydia (Completionist)
arydia_completionist.description: Exhaustive exploration of every province, secret dungeon, character Path mastery, and ancient continent secret.

milestones.title: First Footsteps in Arydia
milestones.description: Arriving in exile, establishing your camp, and discovering the first settlements and local factions in the untamed wilderness.

milestones.title: The Expanding Horizon
milestones.description: Unveiling new overland map sectors, unlocking advanced Path skill cards, and uncovering ancient ruins across the wilderness.

milestones.title: The Shadow Over Arydia
milestones.description: Confronting rising threats across the provinces, braving perilous subterranean lairs, and forging pivotal alliances with provincial leaders.

milestones.title: The Sovereign'''s Pardon
milestones.description: Resolving the existential crisis threatening the continent, achieving supreme mastery of your Path, and securing your pardon to seal your enduring legacy.
